command: ./gradlew test --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair admits the exact candidate blob entry and refuses the next directory entry' --no-daemon -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild -x generateFrontendAssetManifest -x verifyFrontendAssets

scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: Two fresh projects have identical baseline source and blob-name sets S. The test derives B from the distinct existing blob names and verifies the candidate digest is absent. With maximumStateDirectoryEntries=B+1, the scripted peer acknowledges a 4,096-byte replacement and exact readback; the completed receipt records one MODIFIED path with the accepted preimage and candidate postimage hashes, two allowed filesystem callbacks, and verified process/sandbox cleanup. The candidate reaches the injected validator, which confirms its bytes and candidate-set revision digest before throwing its expected sentinel. With maximumStateDirectoryEntries=B, the same ACP write/readback completes, then active graph admission fails with the exact projected-entry diagnostic before the candidate blob is retained. That case has zero validator calls. Both projects preserve accepted source/Makefile/head, reject the attempt, retain a receipt-linked rejected assessment, record the expected terminal run status, clear pending state, and report recoveredAfterCrash=false. Final blob inventory is S plus the candidate at equality and exactly S on refusal.
